jobs.description: To support our initiatives for further adoption of Philips technology providing Class IA guideline treatment options, we are expanding our International marketing team with a Business Marketing Manager DACH, responsible for the full IGTD product and solutions portfolio.The Business Marketing Manager is the dedicated field-based marketing owner for the DACH market zone, covering Germany, Austria and Switzerland. Partner with KOLs and professional societies to strengthen Philips’ position in focus markets.- Work under limited supervision and broad guidelines, serving as the primary marketing contact for assigned portfolio areas and focus markets.- Define proposals for the mid-term marketing strategy, identifying key market challenges and opportunities early and implementing business plans and goals accordingly.You're the right fit if:- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Healthcare, or related field.- 3–5 years of experience in downstream marketing, preferably in healthcare, medtech, or related industries.- Demonstrated experience managing a broad product and solutions portfolio (not limited to a single category or technology platform).- Proven ability to lead dedicated market initiatives – owning the full marketing cycle from strategy to execution within specific geographies.- Strong execution skills with the ability to adapt global strategies for local impact.- Excellent presentation, communication, and stakeholder management abilities.- Knowledge of image-guided therapy, interventional systems, or healthcare technology is a plus.- Must be fluent in German and English languages.- Willingness to travel 50–60% of time.Doing meaningful work should come with fair, transparent rewards. We will share the full approach with you during the interview process, so you can make a clear, informed decision.Benefits include:- Annual leave: 30 days- Mobility and devices: subsidized Germany ticket, leasing opportunities for private use (bicycles, cars, smartphones, ...)- Philips University & Philips in Balance: wide range of professional training courses for personal development and healthcare- Philips Pension Fund: employer-funded pension plan- Philips Partnerzeit: two paid weeks off after your partner has given birth- Philips MyShop: discount on Philips products- Culture: informal culture, a paid day for voluntary work, various team and cultural activities, etc.How we work togetherField roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.About PhilipsWe are a health technology company.
